verdict.rationale: Viam documents a full public API (gRPC-based, per-component methods like GetImage), SDKs in multiple languages, a CLI that can 'call any API method a machine serves, with JSON in and JSON out', and an explicit guide for AI agents driving machines via shell or SDK. This directly matches the ai-native/agenticness story. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe returned 404s) and no independent third-party corroboration of agent-driven API use beyond Viam's own docs.
